description.value:
Your ability to create a healing space in the name of your deity improves. When you use Holy or Unholy Water in your Font of Recovery, the amount of healing increases to @Damage[12[healing]] hit points on a success if the check succeeds against a DC of 30, or @Damage[24[healing]] hit points if it was a critical success.

You can spend an additional vial of Holy or Unholy Water before making your Religion check to grant an additional bonus of your choice, conferred to a creature benefiting from your font of recovery when they first leave your sacred space:

  • You grant 5 temporary hit points for 1 hour. This increases to 10 points if you become Legendary in Religion.

  • You grant a +1 status bonus to AC or saving throws. This bonus lasts for 1 hour or against the next attack or spell made by creatures who are enemies of your deity or has the opposite sanctification of the water used. This bonus increases to +2 if you become Legendary in Religion.

  • You double the healing from resting in the space after 30 minutes, rather than an hour. You double the healing after 10 minutes instead if you become Legendary in Religion.
